# Error catalog

Generated by `pnpm errors:generate`; edit `tools/errors/catalog.json`.

| Public code       | HTTP | Class      | Retry owner | Message                                                  |
| ----------------- | ---- | ---------- | ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| invalid_input     | 400  | validation | never       | Text must contain 1–1000 characters and no extra fields. |
| invalid_json      | 400  | validation | never       | Request body must be valid JSON.                         |
| writes_disabled   | 403  | forbidden  | never       | Writes are disabled in this environment.                 |
| permission_denied | 403  | forbidden  | never       | Access to the requested host was not granted.            |
| sender_forbidden  | 403  | forbidden  | never       | Only the extension's own pages may make this request.    |
| not_found         | 404  | not_found  | never       | Note, route or selected feature not found.               |
| unavailable       | 503  | transient  | owner_only  | The service is unavailable.                              |
| cancelled         | 499  | cancelled  | never       | The operation was cancelled.                             |
| internal_error    | 500  | unknown    | owner_only  | The operation could not be completed.                    |

Internal to public projection:

- `input_invalid` → `invalid_input`
- `request_json_invalid` → `invalid_json`
- `write_forbidden` → `writes_disabled`
- `resource_missing` → `not_found`
- `storage_failed` → `internal_error`
- `response_invalid` → `internal_error`
- `network_failed` → `unavailable`
- `clef_unavailable` → `unavailable`
- `ipc_failed` → `unavailable`
- `export_failed` → `internal_error`
- `state_unavailable` → `unavailable`
- `clock_invalid` → `internal_error`
- `unexpected_failure` → `internal_error`
- `operation_cancelled` → `cancelled`
- `queue_full` → `unavailable`
- `host_permission_denied` → `permission_denied`
- `sender_forbidden` → `sender_forbidden`
- `model_refused` → `unavailable`
- `audio_unsupported` → `unavailable`
- `capture_failed` → `unavailable`
- `capture_not_invoked` → `permission_denied`
